title: Welcome Companion: adaptive setup sequencer and contextual playbooks
creator: Olivia Chen
description: Introduce a lightweight in-product ‘Welcome Companion’ that adaptively surfaces a short sequenced setup experience based on user signal (account age, first API calls, chosen use case). The companion combines three UI primitives: a small persistent coach panel, contextual tooltips anchored to relevant console surfaces (dashboards, rollouts, cost views), and a library of one-click seed templates. Primary goals: reduce time-to-first-success, teach cost controls, and prevent confusion in empty states without adding modal friction.
acceptance_criteria: Persistent companion appears for new accounts and can be dismissed; dismissal state syncs to user profile
At least three use-case playbooks (chat integration, batch embeddings, dedicated capacity) are available as seed templates
Tooltips are contextual and only shown once per user for a given surface; rules defined in Console telemetry events
Prototype validated with 5 engineering and 8 PM/design reviewers; feedback items captured and prioritized
Design tokens and spacing follow Console theme; accessible at 4.5:1 contrast for key CTA text
engineering_notes: Prefer non-blocking iframe-less implementation; use React components wired to feature flag 'welcome-companion-v2'
Telemetry events required: companion_shown, companion_dismissed, playbook_launched, tooltip_shown_{surface}
Seed templates saved as server-side JSON bundles; verify migration for existing sample projects
Cost microcards should read live usage snapshot via cost-summary endpoint to avoid synthetic numbers
risks: Over-eager tooltips may annoy returning users — need robust suppression rules
Seed projects could expose internal endpoints if not sanitized; engineering must audit payloads
Cost figures might diverge from billing if sampling window mismatches; coordinate with Cost team
